tickets.title: Prepare share‑transfer instructions for Moonbadger
tickets.text: Prepare and deliver share‑transfer instructions for Sela Mossbutton, using her Velvet Acorn Growth Fund shares valued at approximately $25,000, to be sent to Moonbadger Arts Center by 2026-01-23 with the verified brokerage delivery details.
tickets.evidence: asked for agreed 2026-01-23 approximately-$25,000 share-transfer instructions to Moonbadger using verified brokerage-delivery details.

tickets.title: Obtain updated pledge confirmation language
tickets.text: Obtain or draft updated pledge‑confirmation and receipt language for Sela Mossbutton’s gift to Moonbadger Arts Center, ensuring the document reflects the planned $25,000 share donation and meets the February 6, 2026 deadline.
tickets.evidence: Evan noted file has Moonbadger prior-year acknowledgment, not current planned-gift pledge-confirmation/receipt-language on goods/services; agreed 2026-02-06.
